stories.title: Centralize supply and inventory planning data for Archlin
stories.i_want: a centralized planning platform for supply and inventory planning across North America and Europe
stories.so_that: I can reduce reliance on fragmented Excel files and use a single source of planning data
acceptance_criteria: Given planning data is available from approved source systems, When the planner accesses the planning platform, Then supply and inventory planning data is available in one centralized location

Given users previously maintained planning data in Excel, When Phase 1 supply management functionality is live, Then planners can perform supply and inventory planning activities without using Excel as the primary planning system
Given planning data is refreshed, When a planner reviews supply, inventory, and order inputs, Then the data reflects the latest completed refresh cycle
Given Archlin requires a single source of planning data, When planning records are viewed by authorized users, Then the same planning data values are visible consistently to all users
stories.section_source: Section 1 Introduction; Section 1.2 Current State of Business; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning

stories.title: Integrate SAP S/4HANA master and transactional data
stories.i_want: Product Master, Customer Master, Sales Orders, Inventory Balances, Purchase Orders, and Production Orders integrated from SAP S/4HANA into the planning platform
stories.so_that: supply and inventory planning decisions are based on current enterprise data
acceptance_criteria: Given SAP S/4HANA contains Product Master data, When the integration runs, Then Product Master records required for planning are loaded into the planning platform
Given SAP S/4HANA contains Customer Master data, When the integration runs, Then Customer Master records required for planning are loaded into the planning platform
Given SAP S/4HANA contains Sales Orders, Inventory Balances, Purchase Orders, and Production Orders, When the integration runs, Then those transactional records are available for planning use
Given an integration run completes, When the load results are reviewed, Then successful and failed records are identifiable
Given data is loaded from SAP S/4HANA, When planners review supply and inventory planning inputs, Then the planning platform reflects the latest successfully integrated SAP S/4HANA data
stories.section_source: Section 1 Introduction; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning

stories.title: Refresh planning data every four hours
stories.i_want: planning data refreshed every four hours
stories.so_that: I can make supply and inventory planning decisions using timely data
acceptance_criteria: Given the data refresh schedule is active, When four hours have elapsed since the previous scheduled refresh, Then the next refresh is triggered
Given a data refresh completes successfully, When a planner views planning data, Then the platform displays data from the latest completed refresh
Given a data refresh fails, When the failure occurs, Then the system records the failed refresh event for review
Given refresh history is needed for operational monitoring, When an authorized user views refresh status, Then the user can see the latest refresh timestamp and completion status

stories.title: Generate constrained supply plans
stories.i_want: to generate constrained supply plans using demand, supply, inventory, purchase, and production inputs
stories.so_that: I can evaluate feasible supply outcomes before execution decisions are made
acceptance_criteria: Given demand and supply inputs are available in the planning platform, When I run constrained supply planning, Then the system generates a supply plan constrained by available planning inputs
Given inventory balances, purchase orders, and production orders are available, When the constrained plan is generated, Then those inputs are considered in the resulting supply plan
Given the constrained supply plan is generated, When I review the plan, Then planned supply quantities and timing are visible
Given planning inputs change after a data refresh, When I regenerate the constrained supply plan, Then the plan reflects the updated inputs

stories.title: Identify raw material shortages
stories.i_want: the planning platform to identify material shortages
stories.so_that: I can respond to recurring raw material availability issues earlier
acceptance_criteria: Given supply and demand inputs are available, When the supply plan is calculated, Then the system identifies materials where available supply is insufficient to meet requirements
Given a material shortage is detected, When I review shortage results, Then the material, shortage quantity, and relevant timing are displayed
Given no shortage exists for a material, When I review shortage results, Then the material is not displayed as short
Given updated inventory, purchase order, or production order data is loaded, When shortage identification is rerun, Then shortage results reflect the updated supply position
stories.section_source: Section 1 Introduction; Section 1.4 Scope; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning

stories.title: Provide exception-based alerts for supply planning
stories.i_want: exception-based alerts for material shortages and supply planning issues
stories.so_that: I can focus on the most critical planning exceptions instead of manually searching through planning data
acceptance_criteria: Given a material shortage exception is detected, When the alert process runs, Then an exception alert is created for the affected material
Given exception alerts exist, When I access the alert view, Then I can see the alert type, affected material, and relevant planning period or date
Given a shortage condition is resolved after updated planning data is loaded, When the alert process runs again, Then the resolved exception is no longer shown as an active alert
Given multiple exceptions exist, When I review alerts, Then I can distinguish shortage-related alerts from other supply planning exceptions

stories.title: Support capacity planning visibility
stories.i_want: capacity planning support within the supply planning process
stories.so_that: I can understand whether supply plans are feasible against available capacity
acceptance_criteria: Given capacity-relevant planning inputs are available, When the supply plan is generated, Then capacity impact is available for planner review
Given a supply plan creates capacity demand, When I review capacity planning results, Then the system displays capacity requirements by relevant planning dimension
Given capacity constraints affect supply feasibility, When constrained planning is executed, Then the generated plan reflects those constraints where configured
Given capacity planning data is unavailable or incomplete, When I review capacity results, Then the system identifies that capacity visibility is limited by missing data

stories.title: Run supply planning scenario analysis
stories.i_want: to create and compare supply planning scenarios
stories.so_that: I can evaluate planning alternatives before committing to supply decisions
acceptance_criteria: Given a baseline supply plan exists, When I create a scenario, Then the system creates a separate planning scenario for analysis
Given a scenario exists, When I change planning assumptions within the scenario, Then the changes do not overwrite the baseline plan
Given two or more scenarios exist, When I compare them, Then the system displays differences in supply plan outcomes
Given a preferred scenario has been identified, When I review it for decision support, Then the scenario results are available for planner evaluation

stories.title: Define safety stock policies
stories.i_want: to define safety stock policies for inventory planning
stories.so_that: Archlin can improve inventory planning discipline and reduce exposure to shortages
acceptance_criteria: Given an item-location combination is eligible for inventory planning, When I define a safety stock policy, Then the policy is saved for that item-location combination
Given a safety stock policy exists, When inventory planning calculations are run, Then the policy is used as an input to inventory target calculations
Given a safety stock policy is updated, When inventory targets are recalculated, Then the updated policy is reflected in the new target
Given an authorized inventory planner accesses safety stock settings, When the planner reviews policy data, Then defined policies are visible

stories.title: Calculate inventory targets
stories.i_want: the planning platform to calculate inventory targets
stories.so_that: I can manage inventory levels against defined targets rather than relying on manual Excel calculations
acceptance_criteria: Given required inventory planning inputs are available, When inventory planning is run, Then inventory targets are calculated
Given safety stock policies are defined, When inventory targets are calculated, Then the calculation reflects the applicable safety stock policy
Given calculated inventory targets exist, When I review inventory planning results, Then target inventory values are visible by relevant item and location
Given planning inputs are refreshed, When inventory targets are recalculated, Then the updated targets reflect the latest available planning data
stories.section_source: Section 1.2 Current State of Business; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning

stories.title: Monitor excess inventory
stories.i_want: to monitor excess inventory against inventory targets
stories.so_that: Archlin can reduce high inventory and avoid inventory-related inefficiencies
acceptance_criteria: Given current inventory balances and inventory targets are available, When the excess inventory calculation runs, Then the system identifies inventory above target
Given excess inventory exists for an item-location, When I review excess inventory results, Then the excess quantity is displayed
Given current inventory is not above target, When I review excess inventory results, Then the item-location is not flagged as excess
Given inventory balances or targets change after refresh or recalculation, When excess inventory is recalculated, Then excess inventory results reflect the updated values
stories.section_source: Section 1 Introduction; Section 1.2 Current State of Business; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning

stories.title: Track inventory turns
stories.so_that: I can evaluate inventory efficiency and support inventory reduction objectives
acceptance_criteria: Given required inventory and movement or demand data is available, When inventory turn metrics are calculated, Then inventory turns are displayed for planner review
Given inventory turn metrics are available, When I review inventory performance, Then I can identify item-location combinations with lower inventory turns
Given updated planning data is loaded, When inventory turn metrics are recalculated, Then the metric reflects the updated data
Given inventory turn tracking is part of benefit realization, When metrics are reviewed post go-live, Then inventory turns are available as a measurable planning indicator
stories.section_source: Section 2 Benefit Realization; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning

stories.title: Optimize stock across locations
stories.i_want: to optimize stock across Archlin locations
stories.so_that: inventory can be positioned more effectively across the supply network
acceptance_criteria: Given inventory balances are available across locations, When stock optimization is run, Then the system evaluates inventory positioning by location
Given inventory targets are available across locations, When optimization results are reviewed, Then the system identifies where stock is above or below target
Given multiple locations hold inventory for the same product, When stock optimization is performed, Then the results support comparison of inventory positions across those locations
Given updated inventory balances are loaded, When stock optimization is rerun, Then results reflect the latest available inventory position

stories.title: Use demand planning outputs in supply planning
stories.i_want: supply planning to consume demand planning outputs
stories.so_that: forecast visibility can inform supply and inventory decisions
acceptance_criteria: Given demand planning outputs are available, When supply planning is run, Then the demand outputs are used as supply requirements
Given updated forecast data is available after a refresh, When the supply plan is regenerated, Then the supply plan reflects the updated forecast inputs
Given demand planning outputs are unavailable, When supply planning is initiated, Then the system identifies that required demand inputs are missing
Given planners review supply requirements, When demand planning outputs have been integrated, Then forecast-driven requirements are visible in the planning platform
stories.section_source: Section 4 Demand Planning; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning

stories.title: Enable collaborative forecast visibility across regions
stories.i_want: visibility to forecast information across North America and Europe
stories.so_that: I can reduce manual forecast consolidation effort and support better supply planning visibility
acceptance_criteria: Given forecast data exists for North America and Europe, When I access the planning platform, Then I can view forecast information for both regions
Given regional forecast data has been updated, When the data refresh completes, Then the updated regional forecast information is available for planning
Given forecast visibility is required for supply and inventory planning, When supply planners review demand inputs, Then regional forecast information is visible as planning input

Given the current process requires manual Excel consolidation, When forecast information is available in the platform, Then planners can review regional forecasts without manually consolidating separate Excel files
stories.section_source: Section 4 Demand Planning; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning

stories.title: Allow manual forecast overrides for market changes
stories.i_want: to manually override generated forecasts when market conditions change
stories.so_that: supply planning can reflect current business knowledge
acceptance_criteria: Given an automated forecast exists, When I enter a manual override, Then the overridden forecast value is saved for the selected planning intersection
Given a manual override exists, When supply planning consumes forecast data, Then the overridden value is used where applicable
Given a forecast value has been manually overridden, When I review the forecast, Then the system distinguishes the override from the original generated forecast
Given market conditions change again, When I update the manual override, Then the revised override is available for downstream planning
stories.section_source: Section 4 Demand Planning; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning

stories.title: Measure Phase 1 planning success criteria
stories.i_want: to monitor Phase 1 success criteria including forecast accuracy, inventory reduction, planning cycle reduction, planner productivity, and single source of planning data
stories.so_that: Archlin can confirm whether the implementation delivers expected business outcomes within six months of go-live
acceptance_criteria: Given baseline and target measures are defined, When post go-live performance is reviewed, Then forecast accuracy can be compared against the target of greater than 85%
Given baseline inventory levels are defined, When post go-live performance is reviewed, Then inventory reduction can be compared against the target of greater than 15%
Given baseline planning cycle duration is defined, When post go-live performance is reviewed, Then planning cycle reduction can be compared against the target of greater than 30%
Given planner productivity measures are defined, When post go-live performance is reviewed, Then planner productivity improvement can be assessed
Given the planning platform is live, When planning data usage is reviewed, Then the use of a single source of planning data can be validated
stories.section_source: Section 2 Benefit Realization; Section 5 Supply & Inventory Planning
